interview.name: Pia
interview.answer: The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey—could you check what supplies we already have and let me know if you can bring any tools? I’m trying to avoid doubling up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll check what we already have and see which tools I can bring.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools we need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. Can you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t miss anything?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Gus: I’ll bring my hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a wrench or two. If you think of anything else, just let me know and I’ll add it.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — could you check what tools and supplies we already have and let me know what you can bring? I’m trying to avoid doubling up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve already got and then bring whatever’s still missing so we don’t duplicate anything. If you send me the current list, I’ll compare it and circle back.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: That’d be great, Jules. I’ll send the current list over so we can avoid any duplicates.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details for the repair drive, so I don’t want to guess. Once I’ve confirmed the list, I’ll send you the latest.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that works. Please send the updated list when you’ve confirmed it so I can avoid any duplicate supplies.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the list first and send you the updated repair-drive details once I’ve checked everything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — once you have the final list, send it my way so I can check for overlaps and avoid duplicates.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of the location and timing, and I’ll send you the final list once Cleo finishes counting.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Pia: Thanks — that should help me avoid any duplicate supplies. I’ll wait for the final list before I double-check our inventory.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is still on this weekend, at the community center on Sunday. If you’ve got a fix to flag, send it my way and I’ll keep the urgent ones at the top.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send over the fixes, and I’ll also check what tools we already have so we don’t double up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — that’ll help a lot. Send me the tool list when you can, and I’ll keep the repair priorities lined up.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along any updates on what the repair drive still needs.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. I’m still checking the supply list so we don’t end up with duplicates.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll listen for any gaps and let you know if I hear they still need anything specific. Hopefully we can keep the duplicates down and fill in whatever’s missing.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can check what supplies we already have and bring a few tools if needed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — could you let me know by Friday what’s still missing so I can avoid overlaps?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll check what’s missing and let you know by Friday.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check the inventory first so we don’t end up with duplicate supplies.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Bo: Perfect — just focus on the big missing stuff first, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything urgent.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll check the big gaps first and keep the list tight so we don’t double up.
events.speaker: Pia
